_doc: The calibration matrix as data (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES_CALIBRATION §3). Maps each design surface to one representative animal the axes are measured on, plus the fixed unknown-surface probe. The expected matrix is DERIVED from this + the live registry: every non-default option of every axis applicable to a representative's surface, one _base baseline per animal, and the combo cells. A surface in design_axes.known_surfaces() with no representative here fails the freshness check — the half-formed-entry rule applied to calibration (add a representative when you add a surface class). The `substrate` block is the render substrate DECLARED as data so the CPU-only gate can detect a change without importing the ML stack: changing the seed, base strength, or zimage_unet is a deliberate stale-the-world edit, and the render tool refuses to run when the live factory.ZIMAGE_UNET disagrees with the declaration here. Combo recipes are lifted verbatim from the preserved scratchpad script (calibration_snapshot_20260716/calibrate_axes.py); their names live here, their composition lives in design_calibration.combo_spec.
